text:
Google announced on 2025-03-18 that it had agreed to acquire Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1]. The primary strategic reason for this acquisition was for Google Cloud, under Thomas Kurian, to close a security gap with competitors AWS and Azure [Source: ev-1].

The deal signaled that cloud-security consolidation is viewed as the next battleground of the "cloud wars," driven by AI-driven cloud adoption acting as the key demand driver [Source: ev-1]. This transaction followed Wiz’s rejection of an earlier $23 billion offer from Google in July 2024 [Source: ev-1]. Although announced in March 2025, the deal completed its regulatory and shareholder steps later in 2025 [Source: ev-1].
